title: CKittya
description: A simple UIL (User Interface Library) that does not look like an essential clone.
body:
Unique Interface Library that doesn't look like an essential (vigilant) clone. Supporting multiple UX features like a selection strip, rect drawer, image rendering, textboxes, buttons, text rendering.

NOTE: the mod in the image is a test mod and is NOT included in this mod. This mod is a Library full of useful UX elements. Of which the source code has been published.
